news.title: Can't Tame Us: How King Promise and Chelsea turned a football tournament into a music video
news.title_zh: 无法驯服我们：King Promise 和切尔西如何将足球锦标赛变成音乐录影带
news.body_en: The compelling story of how the music video for 'Can't Tame Us (Chelsea Anthem)' by King Promise was made... The track itself is a love letter, written by one of Chelsea's own to the club's supporters across Africa. It made its debut at a matchday, will feature at fixtures throughout the season, and was officially released on 12 September, as part of our 'London to the World' approach to culture, celebrating the communities that make up the club's global family. Most music videos are built around a concept, then a location is found to fit it. This one worked the other way round. The tournament King Promise built himself, and the park in Nungua he's known since he was a boy, came first; the video, directed by Derrick Arthur, was shaped to live inside both. It was filmed across two real locations: the Rent Paid Football Exhibition Tournament, where King Promise and Chelsea brought the club's new home kit to Africa for the first time, and Nungua SDA Park, the ground where King Promise grew up playing football. The tournament footage carries the scale and the occasion: a football pitch packed with fans, King Promise alongside Chelsea Supporter Clubs from across Ghana, including Team DWP, Team New Media and Amen X Eleven, and our own home kit launch happening in real time. The Nungua SDA Park sequence carries something quieter: King Promise performing the track on home ground, no crowd built for the camera, just the artist and the place that shaped him. Cutting between the two isn't a stylistic flourish. It's the structure of the story itself: where King Promise is now, and where he started. 'Returning to Nungua SDA Park was very important to me because that is where it all started for me. My love for football, spending time playing with my friends and connecting with community through football games was very special to me,' says King Promise. The tournament marked something bigger than a single music video: the first appearance of our new home kit on African soil, and a gathering of Blues supporter clubs from across Ghana. Rather than treat that as a separate marketing moment, the video builds it directly into the story: the kit reveal, the Chelsea crest against the Rent Paid backdrop, and King Promise wearing the shirt on the pitch, all captured as it happened. 'King Promise came to us with the idea for the track and, knowing how much Chelsea means to him, it felt like a really natural collaboration,' says Scott Fenton, brand director at Chelsea Football Club. 'This is about celebrating our fans in Africa and the culture around the club, and showing what Chelsea can mean beyond the 90 minutes. Music is such a powerful way to bring people together, and this is a brilliant example of that.' For King Promise, the collaboration isn't a brand tie-in bolted onto a song; it's the continuation of a lifelong relationship with the club, one that runs through his childhood in Nungua and idols like Michael Essien. That part of the story gets its own telling elsewhere; here, it shows up simply as a musician wearing the shirt he's loved since he was a boy, on the day it mattered most.
news.body_zh: 讲述 King Promise 的《Can't Tame Us（切尔西国歌）》音乐录影带的制作过程的引人入胜的故事……这首歌本身就是一封情书，由切尔西的一位员工写给俱乐部在非洲各地的支持者。它在比赛日首次亮相，并将在整个赛季的比赛中亮相，并于 9 月 12 日正式发布，作为我们“伦敦走向世界”文化的一部分，庆祝构成俱乐部全球大家庭的社区。大多数音乐视频都是围绕一个概念构建的，然后找到适合它的位置。这个则相反。 King Promise 自己建造的锦标赛以及他从小就知道的 Nungua 公园是第一位的；该视频由德里克·阿瑟 (Derrick Arthur) 执导，旨在融入两者之中。该片在两个真实地点拍摄：租金支付足球表演赛，King Promise 和切尔西首次将俱乐部的新主场球衣带到非洲；以及 Nungua SDA Park，King Promise 从小踢足球的地方。比赛镜头体现了规模和场合：挤满球迷的足球场、King Promise 以及来自加纳各地的切尔西支持者俱乐部，包括 Team DWP、Team New Media 和 Amen X Eleven，以及我们自己的主场球衣实时发布。 Nungua SDA 公园的场景有些安静：King Promise 在主场表演这首歌，没有为镜头聚集的人群，只有艺术家和塑造他的地方。两者之间的切换并不是一种风格上的华丽。这是故事本身的结构：国王承诺现在在哪里，以及他开始的地方。 “回到 Nungua SDA 公园对我来说非常重要，因为那是我一切的起点。我对足球的热爱、花时间与朋友一起踢球以及通过足球比赛与社区建立联系对我来说非常特别，”King Promise 说道。这场比赛标志着比单一音乐视频更重要的事情：我们的新主场球衣首次在非洲土地上亮相，以及来自加纳各地的蓝调支持者俱乐部的聚会。该视频并没有将其视为一个单独的营销时刻，而是直接将其融入到故事中：球衣展示、在“已付租金”背景下的切尔西队徽以及国王诺言在球场上穿着这件球衣，所有这些都在发生时被捕捉到。切尔西足球俱乐部品牌总监斯科特·芬顿 (Scott Fenton) 表示：“King Promise 向我们提出了这条赛道的想法，并且知道切尔西对他来说意味着什么，这感觉就像一次非常自然的合作。” “这是为了庆祝我们在非洲的球迷和俱乐部的文化，并展示切尔西在 90 分钟之后的意义。音乐是将人们聚集在一起的强大方式，这就是一个很好的例子。”对于 King Promise 来说，这次合作并不是将品牌与歌曲捆绑在一起；而是将品牌与歌曲捆绑在一起。这是与俱乐部终生关系的延续，这种关系贯穿了他在农瓜的童年和迈克尔·埃辛等偶像。故事的这一部分在其他地方也有自己的讲述。在这里，它仅仅表现为一位音乐家在最重要的一天穿着他从小就喜欢的衬衫。

news.title: Melvine Malard on giving a lot for a good point
news.title_zh: 梅尔文·马拉德 (Melvine Malard) 为取得好成绩付出了很多
news.body_en: Melvine Malard felt the point Chelsea earned at the end of an intense European encounter against her former club Lyon was a deserved one. Off the back of a rapid turnaround from Sunday’s demanding clash with Arsenal, the Blues were forced to dig deep during an entertaining draw with the most successful club in Women's Champions League history. Malard, who was tasked with leading the attack against familiar faces, highlighted the competitive nature of the contest and the character shown by the squad. ‘There was some good play,’ said Malard. ‘It was a good battle. That’s why it’s a good result, because there was attacking, there was defending, there were chances. So we keep the point. ‘We played three days ago against Arsenal in a match where we gave a lot. Here as well we gave a lot. In the first half, we could have attacked them a bit more, but especially with LJ’s last shot, we could have scored. But it’s a good result for us.’ Occupying the focal point of the Chelsea attack, the 24-year-old was handed important tactical responsibilities by Sonia Bompastor, who was also coming up against her former side. Malard faced a resolute Lyon defensive line but worked tirelessly for the good of the team, and she explained afterwards what her role in the side was. ‘I have a position where I often have to try to hold the ball as high as possible and help the balance of our midfielders,’ she explained. ‘Lyon have a good defence which is well marshalled, but I think it went well and in terms of intensity, defence, attack, we matched them.’
news.body_zh: 梅尔文·马拉德认为切尔西在欧洲赛场对阵老东家里昂的激烈比赛中获得的这一分是当之无愧的。在周日与阿森纳的激烈交锋中迅速扭转局面后，蓝军被迫在与女足冠军联赛历史上最成功的俱乐部的一场有趣的平局中深入挖掘。马拉德负责领导对熟悉面孔的进攻，他强调了比赛的竞争性和球队所表现出的性格。 “有一些精彩的比赛，”马拉德说。 ‘这是一场精彩的战斗。这就是为什么这是一个好的结果，因为有进攻，有防守，有机会。所以我们保留这一点。 “三天前，我们在对阵阿森纳的比赛中付出了很多。在这里我们也付出了很多。上半场，我们本来可以对他们进攻更多一些，但尤其是LJ的最后一脚射门，我们本来可以得分。但这对我们来说是一个很好的结果。” 这位 24 岁的球员占据了切尔西进攻的焦点，索尼娅·邦帕斯托 (Sonia Bompastor) 赋予了他重要的战术职责，而索尼娅·邦帕斯托也将对阵她的前东家。马拉德面对着坚决的里昂防线，但为了球队的利益而不知疲倦地工作，她事后解释了自己在球队中的角色。 “在我的位置上，我经常需要尝试尽可能高地持球，帮助我们的中场保持平衡，”她解释道。 “里昂的防守很好，组织得很好，但我认为进展顺利，在强度、防守、进攻方面，我们与他们不相上下。”

news.title: Chelsea's Ultimate Goal of the Season: the quarter-final vote
news.title_zh: 切尔西本赛季的终极目标：四分之一决赛投票
news.body_en: We have reached the quarter-final stage in our search for Chelsea’s Ultimate Goal of the Season, with eight superlative strikes competing to make it through to the four semi-final spots. The eight goals to have advanced were scored by five Chelsea legends, with three alone from the imperious Eden Hazard and two stunners from Michael Essien. They cover two decades of Chelsea history and include everything from acrobatic finishes to mazy dribbles and long-range thunderbolts. Each goal will no doubt bring back its own special memories for Blues fans and have a place in the heart of all Chelsea supporters, making the decision that much harder. The quarter-finals begin with Essien facing off against himself, with his rasping 30-yard effort against Arsenal taking on his magnificent left-footed volley versus Barcelona. Hazard’s first quarter-final entry is his famous top-corner equaliser against Tottenham Hotspur, taking on that memorable Ramires chip in the Nou Camp. And the magical Belgian is guaranteed at least one semi-final spot as he goes up against himself in the third tie, with his sublime run and finish at Anfield facing off against his powerful solo run against Arsenal. Rounding off our quarter-finals are two of the most recent entrants to our Goal of the Season catalogue. Last season’s sumptuous overhead strike from Joao Pedro takes on Moises Caicedo’s outrageous effort from the halfway line in 2024. You can watch all the pairings below, relive each special moment and choose your favourite in each quarter-final by voting in our four polls on the Chelsea Official App. These will be tight, so make sure you have your say! Michael Essien vs Arsenal - 2007 Essien’s strike made it out of Group A and it is not difficult to see why. With the Blues behind to Arsenal at Stamford Bridge, Frank Lampard laid the ball off to Michael around 30 yards out and the midfielder let rip with a glorious swerving strike that flew into the top corner. Michael Essien vs Barcelona - 2009 Essien’s second contender for the Ultimate Goal of the Season title also came at Stamford Bridge. This time, in the Champions League, where his incredible left-footed effort crashed in off the underside of the crossbar. The Ghanaian met a looping ball on the volley from outside the box and watched as it flew in off the crossbar to give us the lead against Barcelona. On an unforgettable night at the Nou Camp, Ramires’s strike brought us level in the tie and ahead on away goals, setting us on course to our first Champions League trophy. The Brazilian raced on to Frank Lampard’s exquisitely weighted pass and produced the most audacious of finishes as his first-time chip over Victor Valdes found the back of the net. Eden Hazard vs Tottenham - 2016 A fabulous goal saw Eden Hazard end Spurs’ Premier League title hopes during the famous ‘Battle of the Bridge’ match. Linking up superbly with Diego Costa, Hazard latched onto the return ball and curled a beautiful first-time effort into the top corner to send the Blues faithful into delirium. Eden Hazard vs Liverpool - 2019 Hazard once again did it himself when settling a Carabao Cup tie at Anfield. After receiving the ball in the middle of the park, Eden nutmegged Roberto Firmino before exchanging passes with Cesar Azpilicueta. Hazard then burst into the box, producing a second nutmeg on his run, this time on Alberto Moreno, before firing in an unstoppable finish across goal from a tight angle. A truly wondrous moment from the sensational star. Two of Hazard’s most glorious Chelsea efforts go head to head in this tie, with his strike against Arsenal showing everything Eden had to offer the Blues. Picking up possession inside his own half, the Belgian showed his strength to shrug off Francis Coquelin while retaining his balance to take on the Arsenal backline before calmly beating Petr Cech to register a sensational solo goal. Joao Pedro vs Nottingham Forest - 2026 Joao Pedro made it 20 for the season in his debut campaign with a sensational strike against Nottingham Forest. Controlling Marc Cucurella’s header with his chest, the Brazilian instinctively produced an acrobatic overhead kick that flew into the far corner of the goal. Moises Caicedo vs Bournemouth - 2024 Few players can have got off the mark for us in such stupendous fashion as Moises Caicedo. Collecting a loose clearance just inside our own half, Caicedo smashed an inch-perfect effort over the desperately retreating defender and into the empty net from the halfway line. Return tomorrow (Friday) to find out the goals that have advanced to the semi-finals - that vote will take place on Saturday, before the grand final on Monday!
news.body_zh: 我们已经进入四分之一决赛，寻找切尔西本赛季的终极进球，八个顶级进球将争夺进入四个半决赛的席位。晋级的八个进球是由五位切尔西传奇人物打进的，其中三个进球来自专横的阿扎尔，另外两个进球来自迈克尔·埃辛。它们涵盖了切尔西二十年的历史，包括从杂技般的射门到迷宫般的运球和远距离闪电般的一切。毫无疑问，每一个进球都会给蓝军球迷带来特殊的回忆，并在所有切尔西球迷的心中占有一席之地，让做出决定变得更加困难。四分之一决赛开始时，埃辛将与自己展开对决，对阵阿森纳时，他以30码的急速射门，对阵巴塞罗那时，埃辛则以华丽的左脚凌空抽射。阿扎尔首次闯入四分之一决赛是在对阵托特纳姆热刺队的比赛中，他在上角扳平比分，在诺坎普球场对阵拉米雷斯那记令人难忘的进球。这位神奇的比利时人在第三场比赛中与自己较量时，他在安菲尔德对阵阿森纳的强大个人进攻中表现出色，保证了至少一个半决赛席位。四分之一决赛的最后一位是最近入选我们赛季最佳进球的两名球员。上赛季若昂·佩德罗 (Joao Pedro) 华丽的头顶射门将与 2024 年莫伊塞斯·凯塞多 (Moises Caicedo) 在中场线的令人震惊的射门一较高下。您可以观看下面的所有配对，重温每个特殊时刻，并通过切尔西官方应用程序上的四项民意调查来选择您最喜欢的四分之一决赛。这些会很紧张，所以请确保你有发言权！迈克尔·埃辛 (Michael Essien) 对阵 阿森纳 (Arsenal) - 2007 年，埃辛 (Essien) 的进球让他们从 A 组中脱颖而出，原因也不难理解。当蓝军在斯坦福桥落后阿森纳时，弗兰克·兰帕德将球传给了 30 码外的迈克尔，这名中场球员一脚漂亮的转身射门，飞入球门上角。迈克尔·埃辛 vs 巴塞罗那 - 2009 年埃辛本赛季终极进球的第二个竞争者也出现在斯坦福桥。这一次，在欧冠联赛中，他令人难以置信的左脚射门击中了横梁下方。加纳人在禁区外接住一记弧线球，看着球飞过横梁，帮助我们在对阵巴塞罗那的比赛中取得领先。在诺坎普度过了一个难忘的夜晚，拉米雷斯的进球让我们在平局中扳平比分，并以客场进球数领先，让我们朝着我们的第一座欧冠奖杯迈进。巴西人紧接着弗兰克·兰帕德（Frank Lampard）精妙的传球，并完成了最大胆的射门，他的第一次射门越过维克托·巴尔德斯（Victor Valdes）入网。伊登·阿扎尔 vs 托特纳姆热刺 - 2016 年，在著名的“大桥之战”比赛中，阿扎尔打进了一个精彩的进球，终结了热刺的英超冠军希望。阿扎尔与迭戈·科斯塔完美配合，接住回球，并在第一时间将一脚漂亮的射门打入球门上角，让蓝军球迷陷入疯狂。埃登·阿扎尔 vs 利物浦 - 2019 年，阿扎尔在安菲尔德的卡拉宝杯比赛中再次亲自上阵。在公园中央接球后，伊登对罗伯托·菲尔米诺进行了肉豆蔻攻击，然后与塞萨尔·阿斯皮利奎塔交换了传球。随后阿扎尔冲入禁区，在跑动中打出第二粒肉豆蔻球，这次是对着阿尔贝托·莫雷诺，然后以势不可挡的小角度射门射门。来自这位轰动明星的真正奇妙的时刻。阿扎尔在切尔西最辉煌的两场比赛在这场比赛中展开了对决，他在对阵阿森纳的比赛中的进球展示了伊登为蓝军提供的一切。比利时人在自己半场拿到控球权，展现了自己的力量，摆脱了弗朗西斯·科奎林的防守，同时保持平衡，挑战阿森纳的后防线，然后冷静地击败切赫，打进一粒精彩的个人进球。若昂·佩德罗 vs 诺丁汉森林 - 2026 若昂·佩德罗在他的处子秀中对阵诺丁汉森林的比赛中打进一记精彩的进球，打入赛季第 20 场进球。巴西人用胸部控制着马克·库库雷拉的头球，本能地踢出一脚杂技般的倒勾飞入球门远角。莫伊塞斯·凯塞多 vs 伯恩茅斯 - 2024 很少有球员能像莫伊塞斯·凯塞多那样以如此惊人的方式为我们取得进球。 凯塞多在本方半场内接到一次松散的解围，一脚完美的射门越过了拼命撤退的防守队员，从中线射入空门。请在切尔西官方应用程序上为我们本赛季终极进球的四分之一决赛投票！明天（周五）回来看看晋级半决赛的目标 - 投票将于周六、周一总决赛之前进行！

news.title: Internationals: Blues duo feature in Argentina win
news.title_zh: 国际比赛：蓝军二人组在阿根廷获胜中发挥作用
news.body_en: Emiliano Martinez and Valentin Barco played in Argentina’s first game since the World Cup final as they thrashed Bolivia 4-0 in a friendly in Cordoba. Martinez played the full 90 minutes and enjoyed a quiet evening in goal. He made one save, with Argentina dominating possession and territory throughout, and finished with the captain's armband. This summer’s runners-up led 2-0 at half-time courtesy of goals from Lautaro Martinez and Nico Paz, and they extended their advantage shortly after the restart through Cristian Romero. Barco was then introduced on 56 minutes, replacing Benfica’s Gianluca Prestianni on the left flank. The 22-year-old, fresh from his full Premier League debut, brought energy and intensity to Argentina’s play, with a fourth goal added from Flaco Lopez late on. Argentina’s second and final friendly of this international window is against Burkina Faso on Saturday evening local time.
news.body_zh: 埃米利亚诺·马丁内斯和瓦伦丁·巴尔科在科尔多瓦举行的一场友谊赛中4-0大胜玻利维亚，这是阿根廷自世界杯决赛以来的第一场比赛。马丁内斯打满了 90 分钟，并在球门内度过了一个安静的夜晚。他做出了一次扑救，让阿根廷队全程掌控控球权和领土，并最终戴上了队长袖标。今年夏天的亚军凭借劳塔罗·马丁内斯和尼科·帕斯的进球在半场以2-0领先，并在比赛重新开始后不久通过克里斯蒂安·罗梅罗扩大了优势。第 56 分钟，巴科上场，取代本菲卡左翼球员吉安卢卡·普雷斯蒂亚尼。这位22岁的球员刚刚完成完整的英超首秀，为阿根廷队的比赛带来了活力和强度，弗拉科·洛佩斯在比赛后期打入了第四个进球。阿根廷本次国际比赛窗口期的第二场也是最后一场友谊赛将于当地时间周六晚上对阵布基纳法索。

news.title: Sonia Bompastor explains McCabe and Girma absences and discusses Lyon return
news.title_zh: 索尼娅·邦帕斯特解释了麦凯布和吉尔玛的缺席并讨论了里昂的回归
news.body_en: After coming through a tough match with a 0-0 draw against her former side Lyon, Chelsea head coach Sonia Bompastor explained why Katie McCabe and Naomi Girma were missing from the side on Wednesday evening. McCabe was praised for her performance against Arsenal on Sunday, but did not appear on the teamsheet for the Women's Champions League match at the Parc Olympique Lyonnais. The team fought hard to earn a 0-0 draw against our French opponents, leaving us with four points from our opening two matches in the UWCL league phase. ‘Katie was sick,’ Bompastor explained. ‘Erin (Cuthbert) and Manaka (Matsukubo) are training fully with the team, and potentially they could be involved in the game at the weekend.’ Girma was also absent from the squad on Wednesday, and Bompastor was able to shed some light on her condition before addressing the problem goalkeeper Hannah Hampton suffered in the final minutes of the match. ‘Naomi got a knock in training,’ she continued. ‘So I think she will be unavailable for maybe a few weeks. ‘I didn't have the opportunity to talk to Hannah. She was able to finish the game. I'll speak to her and see how she is, but hopefully she's good and ready to go again.’ Chelsea defended hard against another top side on Wednesday, keeping our fifth consecutive clean sheet. Despite not coming away with all three points, there were many aspects of the performance that pleased Bompastor. ‘I'm really proud of my team for not conceding here in this stadium against a strong team and a strong attacking line,’ she said. ‘We are also happy about the way we performed with the ball. We were able to exploit different spaces between the lines, but also in the spacing behind. The only thing that was missing was probably the goal. We created enough big chances for us to be able to score tonight. ‘It was a very good game with two top teams. I’m happy it gives a good image of women's football. I’m proud that we could have such a high-level performance after playing Arsenal on Sunday. Both games were very good performances and that gives us confidence.' This is Bompastor’s third season at Chelsea since she left Lyon at the end of the 2023/24 campaign. With the match now over, our head coach was able to explain how she felt about returning to a place that once was home, and discussed how she has developed as a coach since joining the Blues. ‘Tonight was really emotional,’ she said. ‘I spent so much time here at this club, in this stadium, so it felt great being able to see so many people I worked with. ‘Being the Chelsea head coach for Chelsea and coming back to this stadium with my team was a proud moment as well. The experience I got here at Lyon helped me to grow as a manager. I'm much more confident now. I’m different in a good way, I would say. More mature and making better decisions.’
news.body_zh: 在经历了一场与老东家里昂0-0战平的艰难比赛后，切尔西主教练索尼娅·邦帕斯特解释了凯蒂·麦凯布和娜奥米·吉尔玛周三晚上缺席比赛的原因。麦凯布因其周日对阵阿森纳的表现而受到赞扬，但她没有出现在里昂奥林匹克公园举行的女子冠军联赛比赛的阵容中。球队奋力拼搏，0-0战平法国对手，在UWCL联赛的前两场比赛中我们积4分。 “凯蒂病了，”邦帕斯特解释道。 “艾琳（库斯伯特）和马纳卡（松久保）正在与球队一起进行全面训练，他们可能会参加周末的比赛。”周三，吉尔玛也缺席了球队，邦帕斯特在解决守门员汉娜·汉普顿在比赛最后几分钟遇到的问题之前，能够了解她的状况。 “娜奥米在训练中受到了打击，”她继续说道。 “所以我认为她可能要缺席几周的时间。 “我没有机会和汉娜交谈。她能够完成比赛。我会和她谈谈，看看她怎么样，但希望她状态良好，准备好再次出发。”周三，切尔西在对阵另一支顶级球队的比赛中顽强防守，连续第五次保持不失球。尽管没有全取三分，但比赛的很多方面都让邦帕斯托感到满意。 “我真的为我的球队感到自豪，因为他们在这个体育场面对一支强大的球队和强大的进攻线时没有失球，”她说。 “我们也对我们的控球方式感到满意。我们能够利用线条之间的不同空间，以及后面的空间。唯一缺少的可能就是进球了。我们创造了足够多的绝佳机会，让我们今晚能够进球。 “这是一场非常精彩的比赛，有两支顶级球队参加。我很高兴它为女足树立了良好的形象。我很自豪我们在周日对阵阿森纳后能够取得如此高水平的表现。两场比赛的表现都非常出色，这给了我们信心。”这是庞帕斯托自 2023/24 赛季末离开里昂以来在切尔西的第三个赛季。比赛结束后，我们的主教练能够解释她回到曾经的家的感受，并讨论了自加入蓝军以来她作为一名教练的发展情况。 “今晚真的很激动，”她说。 “我在这个俱乐部、这个体育场度过了很多时间，所以能够见到这么多和我一起工作的人感觉很棒。 “作为切尔西主教练并与我的球队一起回到这个体育场也是一个值得骄傲的时刻。我在里昂获得的经验帮助我成长为一名经理。我现在更有信心了。我想说，我在某种程度上与众不同。更加成熟并做出更好的决策。”

news.title: Lucy Bronze: We worked our socks off!
news.title_zh: 露西·青铜：我们竭尽全力！
news.body_en: Lucy Bronze was proud of Chelsea's performance after we fought hard for a 0-0 draw away at Lyon in the Women's Champions League on Wednesday night. The Chelsea vice-captain, who wore the armband in the absence of injured skipper Erin Cuthbert, was awarded the Player of the Match award for another heroic performance in the backline. Bronze won both of her tackles, made three key interceptions and attempted the most passes of any Chelsea player on the evening with 71. The experienced defender explained exactly how tough it was to claim a point from high-level opposition on the night, and was pleased overall with the outcome of the match. 'We dominated possession of the ball, especially in the first half,' Bronze said afterwards. 'We played out their press well, but they had some good counter-attacking moments. 'They were on top at the end of the game, but that's what happens when two top teams play against each other - the momentum swings. 'Both teams had a chance to steal a goal and maybe steal a win, but I feel like a draw at this time of the season for both teams is probably not the worst thing.' The Blues came into the game off the back of an intense week, where we had to fight for a win against a tenacious Austria Vienna side last Wednesday, before claiming another 1-0 victory in a fiercely contested London derby against Arsenal at Stamford Bridge on Sunday afternoon. With that in mind, Bronze was keen to praise a mammoth effort from her team-mates to come through this period unbeaten and with no goals conceded. 'It shows what a tough battle it was today if a defender's getting it!' she said after being told she had been selected as the official Player of the Match. 'As a team, we worked our socks off. 'I'm proud of every single one of us, especially considering we played a really tough game three days ago. We then had to fly to Lyon after that, so to put in a shift like today, I'm really happy with what we've done.'
news.body_zh: 周三晚上，我们在女子冠军联赛中苦苦挣扎，客场0-0战平里昂，露西·布朗兹对切尔西的表现感到自豪。这位在队长艾琳·库斯伯特受伤缺席的情况下佩戴队长袖标的切尔西副队长，因在后防线的又一次英勇表现而被授予本场最佳球员奖。布朗兹赢得了两次铲断，完成了 3 次关键拦截，并以 71 次尝试传球，成为当晚所有切尔西球员中最多的。这位经验丰富的后卫准确地解释了当晚从高水平对手手中夺取一分是多么困难，并对比赛的整体结果感到满意。 “我们控制了球权，尤其是在上半场，”布朗赛后说道。 “我们很好地应对了他们的紧逼，但他们也有一些不错的反击时刻。 “他们在比赛结束时处于领先地位，但这就是当两支顶级球队相互对抗时会发生的情况——势头波动。 “两支球队都有机会偷进一球，也许还能偷取一场胜利，但我觉得在本赛季的这个时候，对两支球队来说，平局可能并不是最糟糕的事情。”蓝军在经历了紧张的一周后进入了比赛，上周三我们必须为战胜顽强的奥地利维也纳球队而战，然后周日下午在斯坦福桥对阵阿森纳的激烈伦敦德比中又以 1-0 获胜。考虑到这一点，青铜热衷于赞扬她的队友们在这段时期保持不败且不失球的巨大努力。 “如果防守者能做到这一点，那就表明今天是一场多么艰苦的战斗！”她在被告知自己被选为本场比赛的官方最佳球员后说道。 “作为一个团队，我们竭尽全力。 “我为我们每个人感到骄傲，特别是考虑到我们三天前打了一场非常艰难的比赛。之后我们必须飞往里昂，所以像今天这样轮班，我对我们所做的真的很满意。

news.title: Match report: Lyon 0-0 Chelsea
news.title_zh: 比赛战报：里昂0-0切尔西
news.body_en: Chelsea kept a fifth consecutive clean sheet as we battled to a 0-0 draw in the Women's Champions League against a determined Lyon side. This was always going to be a special evening as two top sides met in the UWCL league phase at the Parc Olympique Lyonnais. Head coach Sonia Bompastor and her assistant Camille Abily returned to Lyon for the first time since they left for Chelsea in 2024. There were also returns to Lyon for Lucy Bronze, Kadeisha Buchanan, Ellie Carpenter and Melvine Malard, who all crossed paths during their respective spells with the French side. The clear quality of the two teams cancelled each other out for long periods of the game. There were tough challenges all over the pitch as these elite competitors challenged each other to the very maximum level. In the second half, there was high drama with three VAR decisions and a huge save from Hannah Hampton. Yet this was a fair result and a point very well earned away from home against one of Europe's best teams. Head coach Bompastor made two alterations to her starting line-up following Sunday's win over Arsenal, bringing in Veerle Buurman and Sjoeke Nusken for Katie McCabe and Lauren James. Buurman made herself known within 30 seconds of the kick-off, stopping a Lyon attack with one of her perfectly timed sliding tackles on the right-hand touchline. That was a good marker for how the opening exchanges would unfold, as neither side could find any rhythm, with play stopped often for niggly fouls. The first 15 minutes would see us dominate possession with a 61 per cent share of the ball, but our only real attempt on goal was a speculative hooked effort from Malard which went over the bar. Lyon had their first effort on target soon afterwards when a quick break from Melchie Dumornay saw her play a dangerous through-ball to Salma Paralluello, but Hampton was equal to her attempt. Dumornay's pace was causing problems in the middle, and Lexi Potter was penalised for a foul on the Haitian just outside the penalty area just before the half-hour mark. Selma Bacha took the free-kick, and her curling attempt was thankfully too high to trouble Hampton. Neither side seemed willing to fully commit to attack, as the encounter remaining cagey as the clock ticked towards half-time. The second half began with a determined run down the left from Buurman, and as she strode forward, Lyon's Jule Brand brought her down and received a yellow card for the foul. The resulting free-kick saw Nusken felled in the penalty area, and after a few moments of delay, the Video Assistant Referee recommended that the match official view the incident on the screen. No penalty was awarded, seemingly because of an offside against Bronze, although Tarciane did receive a yellow card for the foul on Nusken. After earning a clean sheet in each of our previous four matches, the Blues were defending resolutely once again. The size of Lyon's pitch seemed to make it hard for us to attack with any real purpose, too. The home side had the ball in the net after 70 minutes through Paralluelo, but the attempt was ruled out for offside. The fortunes seemed to have swung in our favour when Lauren James looked to have been tripped inside the box, and the referee immediately awarded a penalty. Yet on closer inspection, it seemed as though the forward had simply lost her footing and VAR cancelled the decision. Both sides seemed happy to play it safe and share the points in the final ten minutes; however, there were some more big chances before the final whistle. For Chelsea, Alyssa Thompson drove to the byline and pulled the ball back brilliantly for James in the centre of the box, but she could only direct her shot at goalkeeper Mala Grohs. Then, a brilliant crossfield ball from Lily Yohannes met the head of Ada Hegerberg, only for Hampton to pull off a superb flying save to deny the competition's all-time leading goalscorer. The VAR checks meant there were eight minutes of time added on to the 90, and Hampton received medical attention after receiving a whack from Temwa Chawinga. Livia Peng was warming up, but Hampton played on. With just seconds still to play, a shot from second-half substitute Maika Hamano went agonisingly wide of the far post with the goalkeeper beaten. In the end, though, the draw was a fair result for both teams after an elite European encounter. We have taken four points from our opening two matches in the Women's Champions League. Our next UWCL challenge is against Roma at Plough Lane on 28 October. We travel to West Ham United in the Women's Super League on Sunday afternoon, before our players head off to represent their respective national teams during the international break. We return to action with a home game against Tottenham Hotspur at Stamford Bridge on 18 October. news.body_zh: 切尔西在女足冠军联赛中以 0-0 战平顽强的里昂队，连续第五次不失球。这总是一个特别的夜晚，因为两支顶级球队在 UWCL 联赛阶段在里昂奥林匹克公园球场相遇。主教练索尼娅·邦帕斯托和她的助手卡米尔·阿比利自 2024 年前往切尔西以来首次返回里昂。露西·布朗兹、卡德莎·布坎南、艾莉·卡彭特和梅尔文·马拉德也重返里昂，他们都在各自效力法国球队期间有过交集。两队的明显实力在比赛的很长一段时间内相互抵消。球场上充满了严峻的挑战，这些精英选手互相挑战到了最高水平。下半场上演了戏剧性的一幕，三项VAR判罚以及汉娜·汉普顿的一次巨大扑救。然而，这是一个公平的结果，并且在客场​​对阵欧洲最好的球队之一时赢得了很好的一分。在周日战胜阿森纳后，主教练邦帕斯特对首发阵容进行了两次调整，用维尔勒·布尔曼和索克·努斯肯换下凯蒂·麦凯布和劳伦·詹姆斯。布尔曼在开球后 30 秒内就展现出了自己的实力，她在右侧边线精准地铲断了一次里昂的进攻，阻止了里昂的进攻。这是开场比赛如何展开的一个很好的标志，因为双方都找不到任何节奏，比赛经常因为犯规而停止。前 15 分钟，我们以 61% 的控球率占据了控球权，但我们唯一真正的射门尝试是马拉德的一次投机性勾射，球高出了横梁。不久之后，里昂首次射门，梅尔奇·杜莫内快速突破，将球传给萨尔玛·帕拉卢埃洛，但汉普顿追平了她的射门。杜莫内的速度在中场造成了问题，莱克西·波特在半小时前禁区外对海地人犯规而受到处罚。塞尔玛·巴查主罚任意球，幸好她的弧线球射得太高，没有给汉普顿带来麻烦。双方似乎都不愿意全力进攻，随着半场时间的流逝，这场比赛仍然保持谨慎。下半场开始，布尔曼左路坚决跑动，当她大步向前时，里昂队的朱尔·布兰德将她放倒，并因犯规而吃到黄牌。努斯肯开出的任意球倒在禁区内，在短暂的延迟后，视频助理裁判建议比赛官员在屏幕上查看这一事件。尽管塔尔西安确实因对努斯肯犯规而吃到黄牌，但似乎是因为对布伦兹的越位而没有判罚点球。在之前四场比赛均保持不失球后，蓝军再次坚决防守。里昂球场的规模似乎也让我们很难进行真正有目的的进攻。第70分钟，主队通过帕拉卢埃洛将球射入网内，但由于越位在先被判无效。当劳伦·詹姆斯看起来被禁区内绊倒时，命运似乎对我们有利，裁判立即判罚了点球。然而仔细观察后发现，这位前锋似乎只是失去了立足点，VAR 取消了这一决定。双方似乎都很乐意谨慎行事，并在最后十分钟分享得分；然而，在终场哨声响起之前，还有一些更大的机会。切尔西方面，阿丽莎·汤普森带球到底线，在禁区中央为詹姆斯漂亮地回球，但她只能将射门对准门将马拉·格罗斯。随后，莉莉·约翰内斯 (Lily Yohannes) 的一脚漂亮的横传球碰到了阿达·赫格伯格 (Ada Hegerberg) 的头球，汉普顿 (Hampton) 完成了一次精彩的飞身扑救，将这位比赛历史上的最佳射手挡出。 VAR检查意味着90分钟的时间增加了8分钟，汉普顿在受到特姆瓦·查温加(Temwa Chawinga)的重击后接受了医疗护理。彭莉薇 (Livia Peng) 正在热身，但汉普顿 (Hampton) 仍在继续比赛。比赛还剩几秒时，下半场替补出场的滨野麻香的射门不幸偏出远门柱，门将被击中。但最终，在一场欧洲精英赛之后，平局对两支球队来说都是一个公平的结果。我们在女足冠军联赛的前两场比赛中拿到了四分。 我们的下一场 UWCL 挑战将于 10 月 28 日在 Plough Lane 对阵罗马。周日下午，我们将前往参加女子超级联赛的西汉姆联队，然后我们的球员将在国际比赛日期间代表各自的国家队出发。 10 月 18 日，我们将在斯坦福桥主场迎战托特纳姆热刺队。切尔西：汉普顿、卡彭特、青铜（中）、布坎南、布尔曼、沃尔什、波特、卡普坦、努斯肯、汤普森、马拉德（詹姆斯 58）未上场替补：彭、斯宾塞、佩尔茨、比约恩、拉斯、德拉戈尼、布朗、哈马诺、巴尔的摩、比弗-琼斯 黄牌：波特 27 里昂：格罗斯、恩根、塔西亚尼（雷纳德） 76), Bacha (c), Brand, Egurrola, Yohannes, Paralluelo (Chawinga 76), Weir (Becho 76), Katoto (Hegerberg 64), Dumornay未上场替补: Endler, Belhadj, Shrader, Benyahia, Lawrence, Swierot, Sangare, Joseph预订: Brand 50, Tarciane 54裁判: Marta Huerta德阿扎

news.body_en: Sonia Bompastor has made two changes to her Chelsea side for our Women's Champions League match against Lyon. After our hard-earned 1-0 victory over Arsenal on Sunday, the Blues headed out to France, where Bompastor will face her former side. The head coach has brought defender Veerle Buurman into the starting XI in place of Katie McCabe, while Sjoeke Nusken replaces Lauren James. It's been an excellent week for Chelsea Academy graduate Lexi Potter, who starts once again next to Keira Walsh in midfield. After drawing the headlines for her excellent performance against the Gunners, the Chelsea Academy graduate was called up to the senior England side for the first time on Tuesday. Lucy Bronze, Kadeisha Buchanan, Ellie Carpenter and Melvine Malard all start against their former side. news.body_zh: 索尼娅·邦帕斯特 (Sonia Bompastor) 在对阵里昂的女足冠军联赛比赛中对切尔西队做出了两项调整。在周日来之不易的1-0战胜阿森纳后，蓝军前往法国，邦帕斯托将在那里迎战她的前东家。主教练让后卫维尔勒·布尔曼（Veerle Buurman）代替凯蒂·麦凯布（Katie McCabe）进入首发阵容，而肖克·努斯肯（Sjoeke Nusken）取代劳伦·詹姆斯（Lauren James）。对于切尔西青训学院毕业生莱克西·波特来说，这是美好的一周，她再次在中场与凯拉·沃尔什并肩首发。在因对阵枪手的出色表现而成为头条新闻后，这位切尔西青训学院的毕业生在周二首次被英格兰国家队征召。露西·布朗兹、卡黛莎·布坎南、埃莉·卡彭特和梅尔文·马拉德都在对阵他们的前东家的比赛中首发。切尔西：汉普顿、卡彭特、青铜（中）、布坎南、布尔曼、沃尔什、波特、卡普坦、努斯肯、汤普森、马拉德切尔西替补：彭、斯宾塞、佩尔兹、比约恩、拉斯、德拉戈尼、布朗、滨野、巴尔的摩、詹姆斯、比弗-琼斯

news.title: Internationals: Kavuma-McQueen nets winner
news.title_zh: 国际赛：卡武玛-麦昆网胜者
news.body_en: Calvin Diakite, Jashayde Greenwood and Gabriel Sambou all started for England Under-18s while Ryan Kavuma-McQueen came off the bench to net a late winner as the Young Lions defeated South Korea 2-1 on Wednesday morning. Kavuma-McQueen, who is currently on loan at Portsmouth from Chelsea, scored the decisive goal in the first minute of additional time, his looping shot finding the top corner. The winger had been introduced on the hour, shortly after England had taken the lead, and at the same time Diakite and Greenwood were withdrawn. The victory means Will Antwi’s squad have progressed to the UEFA Friendship Cup semi-final, having maintained their 100 per cent record to top Group A. They will now face the winner of Group B on Sunday. Scotland Under-19’s were also in action, as Alfie Osborne featured for the full 90 minutes in a 2-0 loss to Ukraine. The 17-year-old played every minute of Scotland's Spanish tour, which concluded this morning.

news.body_en: The results are in and we can now confirm the final two Chelsea players to progress to the quarter-finals of our Ultimate Goal of the Season competition. The fourth and final group contained several spectacular strikes spanning 15 years of action, and in the end it was goals scored by Eden Hazard and Moises Caicedo that you voted the best of the bunch on the Chelsea Official App. Hazard’s was that spectacular solo strike at Anfield that lingers long in the memory, with the brilliant Belgian weaving between several Liverpool players before finishing in style in front of the travelling support. Caicedo’s goal that progressed was no less spectacular, a perfect strike from the halfway line that dropped into the net after Bournemouth’s keeper was caught out of position. It was some way for Moises to open his Blues account! Hazard and Caicedo beat off competition from fellow Goal of the Season winners Ashley Cole (2010), Lewis Baker (2014) and Mateo Kovacic (2022). The quarter-final line-up is now complete and tomorrow (Thursday) we will reveal who is facing who in the knockout stage, with Caicedo (2024) and Hazard (with three selections for 2016, 2017 and 2019) joined by Ramires (2012), Michael Essien (both 2007 and 2009) and Joao Pedro (2026).

news.title: French Connection: The shared history between Chelsea Women and Lyon
news.title_zh: French Connection：切尔西女足和里昂队的共同历史
news.body_en: Our Women's Champions League trip to face Lyon tonight will bring together a remarkable array of connections between the two clubs. Kick-off is at 8pm UK time, with Sonia Bompastor preparing to return to the club where she established herself as one of the most successful figures in the history of the women's game. The Chelsea head coach is far from the only member of our squad and staff with strong links to OL Lyonnes. Assistant coach Camille Abily spent five years working alongside Bompastor on the Lyon coaching staff after her glittering playing career with the French club. Kadeisha Buchanan, Lucy Bronze, Ellie Carpenter and Melvine Malard have all worn the Lyon shirt, while each has their own story to tell about their time in France. It means Wednesday's fixture is about much more than simply two of the biggest clubs in the Women's Champions League meeting again, but a clash between two clubs with so much shared history. For Bompastor, this will be a return to a club that has played such a huge part in her life. She spent two spells as a player at Lyon, from 2006 to 2009 and again from 2010 to 2013, winning six league titles, three French Cups and back-to-back Champions Leagues in 2011 and 2012. After hanging up her boots, she remained at the club, managing the academy for eight years before taking charge of the first team in 2021. Lifting three league titles, she added a French Cup and another Champions League trophy to her collection. In the process, she became the first person to win the Women's Champions League as both a player and a head coach. And Bompastor admits returning to her former club will be a special occasion. ‘It will be an emotional game for me individually, even if the game won't be around me,’ she said. 'The most important thing is for me to prepare the team to perform at their best in that game, but of course it's really a nice thing to just go back to Lyon and play them. They have a really good team, and it will be a great game to see where we are.’ There is also a special connection in the dugout alongside her. Abily was Bompastor's long-time team-mate before eventually becoming her assistant at Lyon, with the pair continuing their partnership when they moved to Chelsea in the summer of 2024. Abily spent five years as an assistant at Lyon and was part of the coaching team that won three league titles and the 2022 Champions League. As a player, Abily won five Champions League titles with Lyon and made more than 150 appearances for France, making her one of the most decorated figures to have crossed the touchline into the Chelsea dugout. Bompastor and Abily are joined by four current Chelsea players who know Lyon particularly well. Bronze spent three seasons in France, winning the Champions League in each campaign, before adding two more Champions League titles during her spell in Spain with Barcelona and signing for Chelsea in 2024. Here, she was reunited with both Bompastor and Abily, having previously played alongside the latter at Lyon. Buchanan's Lyon career lasted five-and-a-half years before she joined Chelsea in 2022, during which she won five Champions League titles and eight domestic trophies. She has since become a mainstay at the heart of the Blues' defence. The defender worked together with Bompastor during the coach's first season in charge of Lyon's senior side. Carpenter is another Chelsea player with strong ties to Lyon. The Australian spent five seasons in France, winning two Champions League trophies and four league titles before moving to London. She was reunited with Malard at Chelsea, having previously played alongside the forward under Bompastor and Abily at Lyon. ‘Obviously we have that relationship from Lyon,’ Carpenter said of Malard. ‘So it's nice to have her on the team.’ For Malard, however, the connection with Bompastor goes back much further. The head coach was instrumental in bringing the forward to Lyon at the age of 14, recognising her talent and helping her to pursue her ambitions in football. ‘Sonia has been so influential, for me and for my family,’ Malard explained. ‘If Sonia had not called my Mum and taken me to Lyon, I would not be here today. She did so much for me when I was at Lyon.’ Now, the pair will return to France together, with Bompastor heading back to the club where she made so much of her history and Malard returning to the place where her own professional journey began. Chelsea and Lyon have met in the Women's Champions League knockout stages twice before, with both ties producing memories that remain firmly etched into the history of this fixture. Lyon won the first leg 2-1 in France, with Erin Cuthbert scoring for Chelsea, before the return at Kingsmeadow ended 1-1 in a dramatic match that saw Chelsea pepper the Lyon goal, hitting the woodwork and missing several chances to take the game to penalties. The enthralling tie ended with Lyon progressing 3-2 on aggregate and ultimately towards another European title. The Blues travelled to Lyon for the first leg, and came away with a famous 1-0 victory thanks to Guro Reiten's fabulous strike. What followed in the second leg at Stamford Bridge has gone down as one of the most dramatic nights in our history. Lyon overturned Chelsea's advantage through goals from Vanessa Gilles and Sara Dabritz, taking a 2-0 lead on the night and 2-1 in the tie. But with the final kick of extra-time, Maren Mjelde held her nerve to convert a penalty to level the aggregate score. Ann-Katrin Berger then became the hero in the shoot-out, saving from Wendie Renard and Lindsey Horan as Chelsea prevailed 4-3 on penalties. Now, more than three years later, the two clubs meet again. Bompastor will walk back into a stadium where she made so much history. Abily will return to the club where she first forged her coaching partnership with the Chelsea boss. Bronze, Buchanan, Carpenter and Malard will face former team-mates. But once the whistle goes, all of those connections will be put to one side. Another chapter in the Chelsea-Lyon story is about to be written.
news.body_zh: 今晚我们将在女子冠军联赛中对阵里昂，这将汇集两家具乐部之间一系列非凡的联系。英国时间晚上 8 点开球，索尼娅·邦帕斯特 (Sonia Bompastor) 准备返回俱乐部，在那里她成为了女子足球史上最成功的人物之一。切尔西主教练并不是我们球队和工作人员中唯一与里昂队有密切联系的成员。助理教练卡米尔·阿比利在法国俱乐部辉煌的职业生涯结束后，与邦帕斯特一起在里昂教练组工作了五年。卡黛莎·布坎南、露西·布朗兹、埃莉·卡彭特和梅尔文·马拉德都曾穿过里昂球衣，而每个人都有自己在法国的故事。这意味着周三的比赛不仅仅是女足冠军联赛中两支最大的俱乐部再次相遇，而是两支拥有如此共同历史的俱乐部之间的冲突。对于邦帕斯托来说，这将是她重返在她的生活中扮演重要角色的俱乐部。她曾在里昂效力过两次，从2006年到2009年，从2010年到2013年，她赢得了六次联赛冠军、三座法国杯冠军，并在2011年和2012年连续两年获得冠军联赛冠军。挂靴后，她留在俱乐部，管理学院八年，然后在2021年执掌一线队。她赢得了三座联赛冠军，又赢得了一座法国杯冠军。以及她收藏的另一座冠军联赛奖杯。在此过程中，她成为第一个以球员和主教练身份赢得女子冠军联赛的人。邦帕斯特承认回到她以前的俱乐部将是一个特殊的时刻。 “对我个人来说，这将是一场情感游戏，即使比赛不在我身边，”她说。 “对我来说，最重要的是让球队做好准备，在那场比赛中发挥出最佳水平，当然，回到里昂和他们比赛确实是一件好事。他们有一支非常优秀的团队，这将是一场精彩的比赛，看看我们现在的处境。”在休息室里，她和她也有着特殊的联系。阿比利是邦帕斯托尔的长期队友，最终成为她在里昂的助理教练，两人在 2024 年夏天转会切尔西后继续保持着合作关系。阿比利在里昂担任了五年助理教练，并且是赢得三个联赛冠军和 2022 年欧冠冠军的教练团队的一员。作为一名球员，阿比利随里昂队赢得了五次欧冠冠军，并为法国队出场超过 150 场，这使她成为越过边线进入切尔西教练席的获奖最多的人物之一。与邦帕斯托和阿比利一起的还有四名现任切尔西球员，他们对里昂特别了解。布隆泽在法国度过了三个赛季，每个赛季都赢得了欧冠冠军，随后在西班牙巴塞罗那效力期间又获得了两次欧冠冠军，并于 2024 年签约切尔西。在这里，她与邦帕斯托和阿比利重聚，此前她曾在里昂与后者并肩作战。布坎南在里昂的职业生涯持续了五年半，之后于2022年加盟切尔西，在此期间她赢得了五次欧冠冠军和八次国内奖杯。此后，她成为蓝军后防线的中流砥柱。这名后卫在邦帕斯托执教里昂高级队的第一个赛季中与他一起工作。卡彭特是另一位与里昂有着密切联系的切尔西球员。澳大利亚人在法国度过了五个赛季，在搬到伦敦之前赢得了两个冠军联赛奖杯和四个联赛冠军。她在切尔西与马拉德重聚，此前她曾在里昂与邦帕斯托和阿比利一起并肩作战。 “显然我们和里昂有这种关系，”卡彭特谈到马拉德时说道。 “所以很高兴让她加入团队。”然而，对于马拉德来说，与邦帕斯托的联系可以追溯到更早的时候。主教练在这位 14 岁的前锋将她带到里昂的过程中发挥了重要作用，认识到她的天赋并帮助她实现自己的足球梦想。 “索尼娅对我和我的家人来说都非常有影响力，”马拉德解释道。 “如果索尼娅没有打电话给我妈妈并带我去里昂，我今天就不会在这里。当我在里昂的时候，她为我做了很多事情。”现在，两人将一起返回法国，邦帕斯特将回到她创造了如此多历史的俱乐部，马拉德将回到她自己职业生涯开始的地方。 切尔西和里昂之前曾两次在女足欧冠淘汰赛阶段相遇，两场比赛都留下了深刻的记忆，并牢牢铭刻在这场比赛的历史中。里昂在法国首回合以 2-1 获胜，艾琳·库斯伯特 (Erin Cuthbert) 为切尔西进球，随后在金麦多 (Kingsmeadow) 的比赛中，切尔西以 1-1 的比分结束了一场戏剧性的比赛，切尔西攻入里昂的球门，击中门框，并错过了几次将比赛带入点球大战的机会。这场精彩的比赛结束了，里昂以总比分 3-2 晋级，最终再次夺得欧洲冠军。首回合蓝军客场挑战里昂，凭借九郎雷腾的精彩进球以 1-0 获胜。接下来在斯坦福桥的第二回合比赛已经成为我们历史上最戏剧性的夜晚之一。里昂凭借瓦妮莎·吉尔斯和萨拉·达布里茨的进球扭转了切尔西的优势，当晚以 2-0 领先，并在平局中以 2-1 领先。但在加时赛的最后一脚比赛中，马伦·米耶德（Maren Mjelde）鼓起勇气罚进点球，将总比分扳平。安-卡特琳·伯杰随后成为点球大战中的英雄，扑救温迪·雷纳德和林赛·霍兰，帮助切尔西在点球大战中以 4-3 获胜。如今，三年多后，两家具乐部再次相遇。邦帕斯特将重返她创造了如此多历史的体育场。阿比利将回到她最初与切尔西主帅建立教练伙伴关系的俱乐部。布隆兹、布坎南、卡彭特和马拉德将对阵前队友。但一旦哨声响起，所有这些联系都将被抛到一边。切尔西-里昂故事的新篇章即将书写。

news.title: Chelsea youngsters called up by England Women youth teams
news.title_zh: 切尔西年轻球员被英格兰女子青年队征召
news.body_en: Chelsea's Nelly Las has been called up to the England Women's Under-23 side ahead of the forthcoming international break, while a trio have been named in the Under-19 squad. The 18-year-old joined Chelsea from Leicester City on a four-year contract in July and made her Blues debut as a second-half substitute during our 1-0 victory away at Real Sociedad earlier in the campaign. The attacking full-back also came off the bench in our 5-0 win at Manchester United on 13 September. The young Lionesses will play against Norway at York City's LNER Community Stadium on Monday 12 October at 7.30pm. The fixture will mark the start of England’s defence of the U23 European Competition title, which they won in April with a 3-0 victory over Sweden in the final. For the 2026/27 campaign, England have been drawn in Group B alongside Norway, Belgium, Portugal and Italy. 'I’m really excited to get the staff and players together for the new season,' said head coach Lydia Bedford. 'It’s going to be an important year for the Under-23s, particularly with a senior World Cup on the horizon, and we want to keep pushing the players and helping them take the next steps in their development. Meanwhile, three Blues have been called to the England Women's Under-19 squad for a triple-header of qualifiers for the 2027 Women's U19 European Championships to be played in Bosnia during the October international break. Chelsea Academy Under-18s Elise Christian and Gabriella Storey have been selected, as has Lois Shooter, who is currently on loan at Nottingham Forest in WSL2. England will play against Denmark at 12pm on Wednesday 7 October, followed by a match against Switzerland on Saturday 10 October, also at 12pm. The third match will be against Bosnia & Herzegovina at 12pm on Tuesday 13 October.
news.body_zh: 切尔西队的内莉·拉斯 (Nelly Las) 在即将到来的国际比赛日之前已被征召入英格兰 23 岁以下女子队，而三人组也已入选 19 岁以下队。这位18岁的球员于7月从莱斯特城加盟切尔西，签订了一份为期四年的合同，并在本赛季早些时候客场1-0战胜皇家社会的比赛中作为下半场替补登场，完成了她的蓝军首秀。 9 月 13 日，在我们 5-0 战胜曼联的比赛中，这位进攻型边后卫也替补出场。年轻的雌狮队将于 10 月 12 日星期一晚上 7 点半在约克市的 LNER 社区体育场对阵挪威队。这场比赛将标志着英格兰卫冕U23欧洲杯冠军的开始，他们在4月份的决赛中以3-0战胜瑞典赢得了冠军。 2026/27赛季，英格兰与挪威、比利时、葡萄牙和意大利同分在B组。主教练莉迪亚·贝德福德说：“我真的很高兴能让员工和球员在新赛季聚在一起。” “对于 23 岁以下青年队来说，这将是重要的一年，尤其是成年组世界杯即将到来，我们希望继续推动球员们，帮助他们在发展中迈出下一步。与此同时，三名蓝军已被征召入英格兰女子 19 岁以下国家队阵容，参加将于 10 月国际比赛日期间在波斯尼亚举行的 2027 年女子 U19 欧洲锦标赛的三场预选赛。切尔西学院 18 岁以下队的埃莉斯·克里斯蒂安 (Elise Christian) 和加布里埃拉·斯托里 (Gabriella Storey) 以及目前被租借到 WSL2 诺丁汉森林队的路易斯·射手 (Lois Shooter) 均已入选。英格兰将于 10 月 7 日星期三中午 12 点对阵丹麦，随后于 10 月 10 日星期六中午 12 点对阵瑞士。第三场比赛将于 10 月 13 日星期二中午 12 点对阵波斯尼亚和黑塞哥维那。

news.title: Chelsea welcomes Topps as Official Trading Card Partner
news.title_zh: 切尔西欢迎托普斯成为官方交易卡合作伙伴
news.body_en: Chelsea Football Club and Chelsea FC Women today announce the expansion of our relationship with Topps, which becomes Official Trading Card Partner of the club on a long-term, exclusive deal. The new partnership includes trading cards, trading card games and stickers for the Topps, Match Attax and Merlin brands. Marking the continuation of a successful collaboration that began in 2018, rooted in creativity, fandom and a shared passion for collecting, the partnership brings the magic of collecting even closer to Chelsea supporters. For fans, it means a closer connection to the moments and history that define Chelsea, with collectibles built around the players and teams they love. To celebrate, Topps met with Levi Colwill, Nathalie Bjorn, Pedro Neto and Sjoeke Nusken to discuss collecting and to chase some of their teammates as they open packs together. The new agreement is exclusive at club level and folds in more player autographs and game-worn relics for fans to chase. It also brings expanded products capturing Chelsea FC Women, further increasing the team's visibility and growing our community of passionate fans. For Chelsea fans and collectors alike, that means access to more premium, first-of-a-kind trading cards and more collectibles than ever before.
news.body_zh: 切尔西足球俱乐部和切尔西足球俱乐部女子足球俱乐部今天宣布扩大我们与 Topps 的合作关系，Topps 成为该俱乐部的长期独家交易卡官方合作伙伴。新的合作伙伴关系包括 Topps、Match Attax 和 Merlin 品牌的集换式卡牌、集换式卡牌游戏和贴纸。此次合作标志着自 2018 年开始的成功合作的延续，双方植根于创造力、粉丝群体和对收藏的共同热情，此次合作让切尔西球迷更贴近收藏的魔力。对于球迷来说，这意味着通过围绕他们喜爱的球员和球队打造的收藏品，与定义切尔西的时刻和历史建立更紧密的联系。为了庆祝，托普斯会见了利瓦伊·科尔威尔、娜塔莉·比约恩、佩德罗·内托和斯乔克·努斯肯，讨论收集事宜，并在一些队友一起打开包裹时追赶他们。新协议在俱乐部层面是独家的，并包含更多球员签名和比赛磨损的文物供球迷追逐。它还带来了吸引切尔西足球俱乐部女足的扩展产品，进一步提高了球队的知名度并扩大了我们热情的球迷社区。对于切尔西球迷和收藏家来说，这意味着可以获得比以往更多的优质、独一无二的交易卡和更多的收藏品。

news.title: Internationals: Rogers helps England to victory as young Blue scores
news.title_zh: 国际比赛：年轻蓝军进球罗杰斯帮助英格兰取得胜利
news.body_en: Morgan Rogers helped England secure their first Nations League win of the new campaign with a 2-0 victory over Czechia, while Chelsea striker Shim Mheuka found the net as our young Blues enjoyed a successful day on international duty. Rogers came into Thomas Tuchel’s starting XI at the Fortuna Arena in Prague and was involved in the move which led to Harry Kane’s second-half goal, after Anthony Gordon had opened the scoring. Our attacking midfielder went close to breaking the deadlock himself around a quarter of an hour into the contest, turning inside the penalty area and curling an effort against the far post. Elliot Anderson and Bukayo Saka's follow-ups were then blocked. Czechia were then reduced to 10 men when Pavel Sulc was dismissed following a VAR review of his challenge on Anderson, although England had to wait until the second half to take the lead. Gordon headed home Trent Alexander-Arnold’s fine cross shortly after the restart, before Rogers helped England double their advantage in the 69th minute. His involvement inside the penalty area left the ball loose for Kane, who finished low into the corner. The Three Lions next travel to Croatia on Saturday, before hosting Czechia at Wembley on Tuesday. Earlier in the day, Mheuka produce a moment of magic to open the scoring as England Under-20s defeated France 2-1 in Spain, with fellow Blue Jesse Derry also featuring. Our striker, currently on loan at Celtic, needed just nine minutes to make his mark, controlling goalkeeper Oliver Whatmuff’s long pass superbly with his chest just inside the France half before driving forward and finishing past Mathys Niflore from outside the area. Mikey Moore then doubled England’s advantage five minutes later before another Blue out on loan, Derry, who is spending the season at Sporting CP, replaced Shea Lacey in the 59th minute. Mheuka was substituted after 74 minutes and Prosper Peter pulled one back for France, but England held on to secure a second successive U20 Euro Elite League victory. They next face Germany on Saturday. Chizaram Ezenwata and Reggie Walsh both came off the bench as England Under-19s recorded a 2-1 victory over Norway in Marbella. The Chelsea pair were introduced in the 70th minute, with Ezenwata replacing Alejandro Rodriguez and Walsh, currently on loan at Wigan Athletic, taking over from Luca Williams-Barnett. Williams-Barnett and Rodriguez had established a two-goal lead before the interval, with Norway halving the deficit shortly after the restart. Goalkeeper Freddy Bernal was an unused substitute as England saw out the win ahead of Friday’s meeting with the United States. Alfie Osborne will be hoping to feature for Scotland Under-19s when they conclude their series of friendlies in Spain against Ukraine tomorrow. The match in La Nucia kicks off at 10am UK time. Calvin Diakite, Jashayde Greenwood and Gabriel Sambou could also be involved when England Under-18s face Korea Republic in the UEFA Friendship Cup in Nyon, Switzerland, at the same time. All three Blues are in Will Antwi’s squad, with that fixture completing England’s group-stage programme before a final placement match on Saturday.
news.body_zh: 摩根·罗杰斯帮助英格兰队以 2-0 战胜捷克队，取得了新赛季的首场国家联赛胜利，而切尔西前锋希姆·姆赫卡则攻入一球，帮助我们年轻的蓝军在国际比赛中度过了成功的一天。罗杰斯在布拉格福尔图纳竞技场进入托马斯·图切尔的首发阵容，并参与了在安东尼·戈登首开纪录后哈里·凯恩下半场进球的举动。我们的攻击型中场在比赛开始后大约一刻钟左右就差点打破僵局，他在禁区内转身射向远门柱。埃利奥特·安德森和布卡约·萨卡的后续行动随后被屏蔽。帕维尔·苏尔克（Pavel Sulc）在对安德森的挑战进行VAR审查后被罚下场，捷克队的参赛人数减少到10人，尽管英格兰队必须等到下半场才取得领先。比赛重新开始后不久，戈登头球破门，特伦特·亚历山大-阿诺德传中，罗杰斯在第69分钟帮助英格兰将优势扩大。他在禁区内的介入让凯恩失去了球权，凯恩低射入角。三狮军团接下来将于周六前往克罗地亚，然后于周二在温布利主场迎战捷克队。当天早些时候，在英格兰 20 岁以下青年队在西班牙 2-1 击败法国队的比赛中，穆卡 (Mheuka) 上演神奇时刻首开纪录，蓝军队友杰西·德里 (Jesse Derry) 也登场亮相。我们的前锋，目前被租借到凯尔特人队，只用了九分钟就留下了自己的印记，他在法国半场内用胸部出色地控制了门将奥利弗·沃特莫夫的长传，然后向前突破，从禁区外越过了马蒂斯·尼弗洛尔。五分钟后，米基·摩尔将英格兰队的优势扩大了一倍，而另一位租借的蓝军球员德里，在里斯本竞技度过了这个赛季，并在第59分钟取代了谢伊·莱西。 74分钟后，姆赫卡被换下，普罗斯珀·彼得为法国队扳回一球，但英格兰队坚持住，取得了U20欧洲精英联赛的连续第二场胜利。他们下周六将迎战德国队。奇扎拉姆·埃森瓦塔 (Chizaram Ezenwata) 和雷吉·沃尔什 (Reggie Walsh) 均替补登场，英格兰 19 岁以下青年队在马贝拉 (Marbella) 2-1 战胜挪威。这对切尔西组合在第 70 分钟登场，埃森瓦塔取代了亚历杭德罗·罗德里格斯和目前租借到维冈竞技的沃尔什，接替了卢卡·威廉姆斯-巴内特。威廉姆斯-巴内特和罗德里格斯在中场休息前建立了两球领先优势，挪威队在比赛重新开始后不久将比分差距减半。在周五与美国队的比赛之前，英格兰队取得了胜利，守门员弗雷迪·伯纳尔在替补席上未上场。阿尔菲·奥斯本希望在苏格兰 19 岁以下青年队明天结束在西班牙对阵乌克兰的系列友谊赛时出场。拉努西亚的比赛于英国时间上午 10 点开始。卡尔文·迪亚基特 (Calvin Diakite)、贾沙伊德·格林伍德 (Jashayde Greenwood) 和加布里埃尔·桑布 (Gabriel Sambou) 也可能参与英格兰 18 岁以下青年队同时在瑞士尼永举行的欧洲联盟友谊杯比赛中对阵韩国队的比赛。所有三支蓝军都在威尔·安特维的阵容中，这场比赛在周六的最后一场定级赛之前完成了英格兰队的小组赛计划。

news.title: Chelsea Women travelling squad confirmed for Lyon
news.title_zh: 切尔西女足阵容确认前往里昂
news.body_en: A 24-player Chelsea squad has been confirmed for the Women's Champions League match away at Lyon. The Blues secured three points in our opening league phase match of the competition with a 1-0 victory over Austria Vienna last Wednesday, before our 1-0 Women's Super League win against rivals Arsenal at the weekend. Tomorrow's match, held at the Parc Olympique Lyonnais, kicks off at 9pm local time, which will be 8pm in the UK. You can listen to live commentary and follow minute-by-minute text updates in our Match Centre. After missing out on the trip to Real Sociedad last month, Nathalie Bjorn and Melvine Malard join the squad that will head to Lyon. Lexi Potter makes the group after it was announced earlier today that the young midfielder had received her first senior call-up to the England squad. Lola Brown – another Chelsea Academy graduate – is also named in the group. Following our trip to Lyon, we will return to domestic action with a game away at West Ham United on Sunday afternoon before our players head off to their various national sides for the international break. Our next home European action will be when we face Italian side Roma on 28 October at Plough Lane. See below for the full list of players travelling to France... Goalkeepers: Hannah Hampton, Livia Peng, Victoria Rudz, Becky Spencer Defenders: Nathalie Bjorn, Lucy Bronze, Kadeisha Buchanan, Veerle Buurman, Ellie Carpenter, Naomi Girma, Nelly Las, Katie McCabe Midfielders: Lola Brown, Giulia Dragoni, Wieke Kaptein, Sjoeke Nusken, Lexi Potter, Keira Walsh Forwards: Sandy Baltimore, Aggie Beever-Jones, Maika Hamano, Lauren James, Melvine Malard, Alyssa Thompson

news.title: Key talking points from Sonia Bompastor's pre-Lyon press conference
news.title_zh: 索尼娅·邦帕斯托在里昂赛前新闻发布会上的主要谈话要点
news.body_en: Sonia Bompastor and Lucy Bronze faced the media at the Parc Olympique Lyonnais on Tuesday evening ahead of their return to face their former side in the Women's Champions League. Here are the stand-out talking points from the press conference... Bompastor represented Lyon as a player before spending eight years in charge of their women's academy side after hanging up her boots. She was then promoted to head coach in 2021, and spent three further years in charge before moving to Chelsea in summer 2024. This is the first time that our head coach has returned to face her former side since her move to England, and there were inevitably questions from the French media on how she is feeling ahead of Wednesday's match. Bronze spent three years at the club between 2017 and 2020. She was asked about playing under legendary French defender Wendie Renard, who has represented Lyon since 2006. Sonia Bompastor: 'It will be full of emotion; that’s obvious.  I’m not the only one on the staff or in this group of players - there are quite a few people who have played or coached here, in this great stadium. 'But there is a match to be played, and that’s the most important thing. My task will be to focus on the preparations and to make sure that my team arrives ready for the match.' 'No, not necessarily. I always want to do well. It doesn't matter what game it is. We've just come off another big game against Arsenal, and we want to shine, to win. 'Yes, this is a special moment, maybe a bit more charged with emotions, but we know how to detach ourselves from that; it’s part of our job. Emotionally and mentally, we know how to prepare so that the match remains the most important thing tomorrow.' 'I have a blast every day being the head coach at Chelsea. Football in England is cultural. It's a culture that is very different from what we have here in France. The Women's Super League is very competitive. 'It was a personal choice to take on this role, because I wanted to challenge myself. I have that chance every weekend in the league, but also in the Champions League. I have the chance to work at a very high-level club at Chelsea. It's a big brand, a big club. I am very happy here, and I take a lot of pleasure from working with this group of players every day.' 'Chelsea are a club with ambitions. So we always build a squad that can compete to win every trophy, especially the Champions League. It's the only one that's missing from the club. 'You have to find the right balance between experienced players and young talent. And then this competition is becoming more and more difficult. There are a lot of clubs now investing in women's football, and sometimes you need a bit of luck to help tip things in the right direction. 'We are not far away. I think we have a team full of quality, a team with a lot of talent, and so we have to approach matches one by one, and also have the mentality to be very competitive. We approach matches with this killer spirit against big opponents.' Lucy Bronze: 'I spent three years at Lyon with Wendie as my captain, and I tell everyone she's the best captain I've ever played under. She's a great player and a great person. I learned so much from her in terms of how she defended her team, how she stood up for people, and the respect that she gained from everyone by doing the right things. 'There are so many words I could use to describe Wendie Renard. I took a lot of the experience that she brought to Lyon, and I try to bring that to Chelsea in terms of leading by example, bringing everyone along with me, and always having the highest standards.'
news.body_zh: 周二晚上，索尼娅·邦帕斯托和露西·青铜在里昂奥林匹克公园球场接受了媒体采访，随后她们将在女子冠军联赛中对阵她们的前东家。以下是新闻发布会上最引人注目的谈话要点……庞帕斯特作为球员代表里昂，在挂靴后执掌里昂女子青训队八年。随后，她于 2021 年晋升为主教练，并在 2024 年夏天转会到切尔西之前又执教了三年。这是我们的主教练自转会英格兰以来首次回归面对她的前东家，法国媒体不可避免地质疑她在周三的比赛前感觉如何。 2017 年至 2020 年间，布隆兹在俱乐部效力了三年。她被问及在自 2006 年以来代表里昂效力的法国传奇后卫温迪·雷纳德 (Wendie Renard) 手下踢球的情况。这是显而易见的。  我不是工作人员或这群球员中唯一的人——有很多人曾在这里、在这个伟大的体育场里踢过球或执教过。 “但是还有一场比赛要打，这是最重要的事情。我的任务是专注于准备工作，并确保我的球队为比赛做好准备。” '不，不一定。我总是想做得好。它是什么游戏并不重要。我们刚刚结束了对阵阿森纳的另一场重要比赛，我们想要大放异彩，想要获胜。 “是的，这是一个特殊的时刻，也许更加充满了情感，但我们知道如何摆脱它；这是我们工作的一部分。在情感上和精神上，我们知道如何做好准备，以便比赛仍然是明天最重要的事情。” “作为切尔西的主教练，我每天都很开心。英格兰的足球是文化性的。这是一种与我们法国截然不同的文化。女超联赛的竞争非常激烈。 “担任这个角色是我个人的选择，因为我想挑战自己。我每个周末在联赛中都有这样的机会，在欧冠中也是如此。我有机会在切尔西这样一家非常高水平的俱乐部工作。这是一个大品牌，一个大俱乐部。我在这里很开心，每天和这群球员一起工作让我很开心。” “切尔西是一家有雄心的俱乐部。因此，我们总是建立一支能够赢得每座奖杯的球队，尤其是冠军联赛。这是俱乐部中唯一失踪的球员。 “你必须在经验丰富的球员和年轻天才之间找到适当的平衡。然后这场比赛就变得越来越艰难。现在有很多俱乐部投资女足，有时你需要一点运气才能帮助事情朝着正确的方向发展。 '我们并不遥远。我认为我们是一支素质很高、人才济济的球队，所以我们必须一场一场地对待比赛，并且要有非常有竞争力的心态。我们带着这种杀手精神去面对强大的对手。露西·布朗兹：“我在里昂度过了三年，温迪担任我的队长，我告诉所有人，她是我效力过的最好的队长。她是一位伟大的球员，也是一个伟大的人。我从她身上学到了很多东西，包括她如何捍卫自己的团队，如何为人们挺身而出，以及她通过做正确的事情赢得了每个人的尊重。 “我可以用很多词来形容温迪·雷纳德。我吸取了她给里昂带来的很多经验，我试图将这些经验带到切尔西，以身作则，让每个人都和我一起，并始终保持最高标准。”

news.title: Leo Black signs for Chelsea
news.title_zh: 里奥·布莱克加盟切尔西
news.body_en: Chelsea Football Club is pleased to announce the signing of Leo Black, who joins the Blues until 2028 following a successful trial. Black, 20, is a versatile player who can play full-back and midfield, and has represented England at Under-18 and Under-19 levels. In August, Black made his debut for Chelsea Cobham Next Gen in our 5-4 win against West Ham. He also scored in our victories against Arsenal and Fulham before the international break. For his impressive performances, Black was nominated for the PL2 Player of the Month for September 2026.
news.body_zh: 切尔西足球俱乐部很高兴地宣布签下里奥·布莱克，他在试训成功后将加盟蓝军直至 2028 年。 20岁的布莱克是一名多才多艺的球员，可以踢边后卫和中场，并曾代表英格兰参加U-18和U-19级别的比赛。 8月，布莱克在切尔西科巴姆下一代队5-4战胜西汉姆联队的比赛中首次亮相。他还在国际比赛日之前我们对阵阿森纳和富勒姆的比赛中进球。凭借令人印象深刻的表现，Black 被提名为 2026 年 9 月 PL2 月度最佳球员。

news.title: Internationals: Estevao Willian features in Brazil comeback
news.title_zh: 国际比赛：埃斯特沃·威廉在巴西复出中发挥重要作用
news.body_en: Blues forward Estevao Willian was a second-half substitute as the Selecao ran out 4-2 winners in an entertaining contest against Australia in Brisbane. Brazil were held to a 1-1 draw with Australia last week in the first of a double-header between the countries over this international break, but our former manager Carlo Ancelotti led his side to a comfortable win in the second clash between the pair. Estevao's Brazil took the lead inside the opening three minutes thanks to an effort from Vanderson before the Socceroos fought back to go 2-1 up after 34 minutes with goals from Alessandro Circati and Connor Metcalfe. That was until Raphinha drew the visitors level from the penalty spot on the stroke of half-time. After the break, Ancelotti made several changes, including introducing Estevao in the 61st minute as a replacement on the right side of attack for Bournemouth's Rayan. Estevao looked bright during his 30 minutes of action, showing some flashes of brilliance on the ball and came close to getting his name on the scoresheet with a left-footed effort that narrowly went over the bar. Brazil went on to win the match through a Bruno Guimaraes strike and a Vinicius Junior penalty as their superior quality and strength from the bench shone through. The 19-year-old could be in action once again on Saturday when Brazil head to Kolkata to take on India in an international friendly, with kick-off set for 2pm (UK time).

news.title: Lucy Bronze excited for Lyon reunion as Chelsea prepare for another big test
news.title_zh: 露西·布朗对里昂重聚感到兴奋，切尔西正在准备另一场重大考验
news.body_en: Lucy Bronze is relishing the chance to return to her former club as we prepare to face another match against top-level opposition on Wednesday evening. The defender spent a hugely successful spell with the French club and will return to familiar surroundings in the Women's Champions League as one of four Chelsea players with previous connections to Lyon. Bronze was delighted to come through Sunday's hard-fought victory over Arsenal with three points, but her attention has already turned towards our next major test. ‘It was a well-earned three points,’ Bronze said. ‘The game kind of went Arsenal's way in the first half, then we stepped it up in the second, and they threw the kitchen sink at us in the end. It was an entertaining game for the fans. It was a really challenging game to play in, but ultimately I was so happy with the three points. It puts us in a great position near the top of the table.’ The full-back has made no secret of her love for playing in the biggest matches, and Lucy is enjoying the prospect of continuing to test herself against Europe's elite with another round of Champions League fixtures in her sights. ‘It's great. I love playing in the big games, the challenging games,’ she added. ‘That's what the best players in the world want to do. They want to play for the best teams, to be able to compete for trophies, to compete in the league. ‘That's exactly what we're doing this season. We're pushing ourselves in every single game to be able to compete and win every trophy we can.’ After securing a hard-fought 1-0 win in the opening match of our Champions League campaign, the Blues are preparing to capitalise on the three points already earned in the competition's league phase. The match will see Chelsea head coach Sonia Bompastor and her assistant, Camille Abily, return to face their former side, and Bronze is already up for the challenge. ‘It's so exciting,’ Bronze said. ‘My time at Lyon was amazing. All the girls, Ellie (Carpenter), Keish (Kadeisha Buchanan) and Melvine (Malard) had a great time at Lyon, and we all actually played there together as well. ‘We're excited to go there, to be focused on the Champions League, and we know what pedigree Lyon have in the Champions League. To go toe to toe with another team who's one of the best in the world and test ourselves and prove ourselves is going to be exciting.’ Bronze's focus is firmly on Wednesday's Champions League trip to Lyon, before Chelsea return to domestic action away at West Ham United at the weekend. However, there will be little time to rest, with another challenge already on the horizon for Bronze as she prepares to represent England against Greece in a vital two-legged World Cup qualification play-off in October. Bronze is a mainstay under Sarina Wiegman, and speaking before Potter was officially included in the England squad on Tuesday morning, she gave her full support for her Blues team-mate joining the senior ranks. ‘I'm not the manager and Sarina will make her choices, but Lexi has been absolutely fantastic,’ Bronze continued. ‘She was last year too. I remember my first season at Chelsea and seeing her train at the level she was. ‘Having a player like Keira to look up to, and base her style off and learn from, you can see in every game they are developing into the same player. If England have another Keira Walsh, it puts us in a very good position! Similar for Chelsea.’
news.body_zh: 露西·青铜很高兴有机会回到她以前的俱乐部，我们准备在周三晚上与顶级对手进行另一场比赛。这名后卫在法国俱乐部度过了一段非常成功的时光，并将作为之前与里昂有过联系的四名切尔西球员之一回到女子冠军联赛的熟悉环境中。布伦兹很高兴能在周日艰苦的比赛中拿下三分战胜阿森纳，但她的注意力已经转向我们的下一个重大考验。 “这是当之无愧的三分，”布朗泽说。 “上半场比赛按照阿森纳的方式进行，然后我们在下半场加大了力度，最后他们把厨房水槽扔给了我们。对于球迷来说，这是一场有趣的比赛。这是一场非常具有挑战性的比赛，但最终我对三分感到非常满意。这让我们处于接近积分榜榜首的有利位置。这位边后卫毫不掩饰她对参加最重要比赛的热爱，露西很享受与欧洲精英队继续测试自己的前景，她的目标是参加另一轮冠军联赛。 '这很棒。我喜欢参加大型比赛、具有挑战性的比赛，”她补充道。 ‘这就是世界上最好的球员想要做的事情。他们希望为最好的球队效力，能够争夺奖杯，在联赛中竞争。 ‘这正是我们本赛季所做的。我们在每一场比赛中都竭尽全力，争取能够参加比赛并赢得每一座奖杯。”在欧冠联赛首场比赛中经过一场艰苦的比赛以 1-0 获胜后，蓝军正准备利用在联赛阶段已经获得的三分。这场比赛中，切尔西主教练索尼娅·邦帕斯特和她的助手卡米尔·阿比利将回归，迎战他们的前东家，而布朗兹已经做好了迎接挑战的准备。 “这太令人兴奋了，”布隆泽说。 “我在里昂的时光非常棒。所有的女孩，艾莉（卡彭特）、凯什（卡黛莎·布坎南）和梅尔文（马拉德）在里昂度过了一段愉快的时光，我们实际上也在那里一起踢球。 “我们很高兴能去那里，专注于冠军联赛，我们知道里昂在冠军联赛中的血统。与另一支世界上最好的球队并肩作战，考验我们自己，证明我们自己，这将是令人兴奋的。”青铜的注意力集中在周三对阵里昂的冠军联赛之旅上，然后切尔西将在周末客场对阵西汉姆联队。然而，她几乎没有时间休息，因为她准备代表英格兰队在十月举行的世界杯预选赛两回合制附加赛中对阵希腊队，她的另一项挑战已经迫在眉睫。铜牌是萨琳娜·维格曼手下的中流砥柱，在周二早上波特正式入选英格兰队之前，她发表了讲话，全力支持她的蓝军队友加入高级队伍。 “我不是主教练，萨琳娜会做出她的选择，但莱克西绝对棒极了，”布朗兹继续说道。 ‘她去年也是。我记得我在切尔西的第一个赛季，看到她按照她的水平训练。 “拥有像凯拉这样的球员值得尊敬，并以她的风格为基础并向其学习，你可以在每场比赛中看到他们正在成长为同一个球员。如果英格兰再有一个凯拉·沃尔什，这会让我们处于非常有利的位置！切尔西也类似。”

news.body_en: Chelsea Women travel to Lyon for what is set to be a thrilling encounter between two top sides on Wednesday night. The match, which is a one-off fixture as part of the league phase format, will see our head coach Sonia Bompastor face her former side for the first time since joining Chelsea in summer 2024. The reunion doesn't stop there, either. Lucy Bronze, Kadeisha Buchanan, Ellie Carpenter and Melvine Malard all played together for Lyon under Bompastor and assistant coach Camille Abily. Here is everything you need to know about how to watch Chelsea Women against Lyon, including kick-off time and how to follow the action on official Chelsea channels. Chelsea Women's game against Lyon takes place on Wednesday 30 September 2026 at the Parc Olympique Lyonnais, with kick-off scheduled for 8pm UK time. Wednesday night's match will be broadcast live on Disney+ in the UK. As always, team news, live updates and match coverage will be provided in our OL Lyonnes vs Chelsea Women Match Centre on the Chelsea Official App and Chelsea website. You can also follow along via Chelsea Women’s social media channels on X, Facebook, Instagram and TikTok. Chelsea came through a tough battle with Austria Vienna to win 1-0 in our first league phase match of the competition, while Lyon delivered an 8-0 thrashing of Servette. In domestic action, the Blues currently sit third in the Women's Super League table after three wins and a draw in our opening four matches of the campaign, while our French opponents have won three from three in their Women's Premiere League. We have faced Lyon twice in the Women's Champions League knockout stages. In 2019, we were trying to establish ourselves as a force in Europe and came up just short with a 2-1 defeat in the first leg away from home before earning a hard-fought 1-1 draw at Kingsmeadow. By 2023, we had vastly matured as a team, and another thrilling tie against the French giants saw us come away with a thrilling last-gasp win to reach the semi-final of the competition. We took the tie to penalties with the last kick of the game in extra time when Maren Mjelde held her nerve to convert an equalising spot-kick in the eighth minute of stoppage time. We would then go on to win a dramatic shoot-out 4-3 after Blues goalkeeper Ann-Katrin Berger saved penalties from Wendie Renard and Lindsey Horan.

news.body_en: Five of our Blues have been selected by England head coach Sarina Wiegman for the forthcoming two-legged UEFA Women's European Qualifiers Play-off against Greece. The Lionesses won five of their six group matches earlier in the year, but it wasn't enough to secure an automatic place in the FIFA Women's World Cup in 2027, which will be held in Brazil. England will play Greece over two legs in Round 1 during the October international break. If they come out on top, they will face the winners of Slovakia's tie against Ukraine in Round 2 of the play-offs, which will be contested in late November and early December. Sarina Wiegman's side will travel to the Pankritio Stadium in Heraklion for the first leg on Friday 9 October. The match kicks off at 7.30pm local time, which will be 5.30pm in the UK. The return leg will be held on Tuesday 13 October at the King Power Stadium in Leicester at 7.30pm. Chelsea's experienced England contingent of Lucy Bronze, Hannah Hampton, Lauren James and Keira Walsh have all been selected by Wiegman, and there is also a first call-up for Chelsea Academy graduate Lexi Potter after she has impressed with a string of appearances in our first team. Striker Aggie Beever-Jones is on England's reserve list after recently suffering a small injury and is only just returning to fitness. Potter signed a three-year contract with Chelsea at 17, becoming the first female player to agree a professional deal at this age. She has been part of the England youth setup from Under-17 level onwards, captaining the Under-17 team that reached the semi-finals of the 2023 UEFA European Championships in Estonia. She was also named captain ahead of the 2024 UEFA Euro U19 Championships and once again reached the semi-finals of the competition at Under-19 level. Most recently, Potter was part of the Under-23 side that won the Women's U23 European Competition in April 2026. news.title: Chelsea's Ultimate Goal of the Season: Group D vote
news.title_zh: 切尔西本赛季的终极目标：D组投票
news.body_en: We have reached the final group in our search for Chelsea’s Ultimate Goal of the Season, with five more spectacular strikes competing for the last two places in the quarter-finals. Groups A, B and C have already put 15 previous winners up for the vote, and Group D completes our line-up with goals from Ashley Cole, Lewis Baker, Eden Hazard, Mateo Kovacic and Moises Caicedo. The five contenders cover 14 years of Chelsea history and include everything from brilliant close control inside the penalty area to extraordinary efforts from distance. There is also something unique about this group. Baker’s 2014 winner came for our Under-21s against Arsenal at the Emirates Stadium, making it the only Goal of the Season winner in our 20-goal field which was not scored for the men’s first team. Alongside it are memorable goals at Stamford Bridge and Anfield, including another piece of Hazard magic - incredibly his third entry into this competition, with the previous two having both advanced already. The two goals which receive the most votes will progress to the quarter-finals, completing the eight-goal line-up for the next stage of our Ultimate Goal of the Season contest. You can watch all five Group D contenders below, relive each special moment and choose your favourite by voting on the Chelsea Official App, so make sure you have your say on which strikes deserve to progress. Cast your vote for Group D of our Ultimate Goal of the Season on the Chelsea Official App here Cole raced on to John Terry’s lofted pass, brought the ball under control superbly in the box, cut inside a sliding challenge and then used the outside of his left foot to dink past the keeper and find the far corner during our 7-2 victory over Sunderland. Baker produced an outrageous finish for our Under-21s at the Emirates Stadium, meeting a cross from Islam Feruz first time and improvising brilliantly with a spinning backheel which flew into the Arsenal net, leaving the keeper looking bewildered. Hazard settled a Carabao Cup tie at Anfield in trademark fashion, surging past Naby Keita, nutmegging Alberto Moreno and then firing an unstoppable finish across goal from a tight angle to complete a 2-1 comeback victory. The goal gets better with every rewatch. With the Blues two goals down at Stamford Bridge, Kovacic met a punched clearance from the goalkeeper with a magnificent first-time volley - while moving backwards - from outside the penalty area, sending the ball in off the post to spark our fightback to a 2-2 draw. Caicedo chose a remarkable way to score his first Chelsea goal, collecting a loose clearance just inside his own half before launching an inch-perfect effort over the retreating defence and into the empty net from the halfway line. Cast your vote for Group D of our Ultimate Goal of the Season on the Chelsea Official App here

news.title: Internationals: Lavia landmark but Lacroix wins battle of the Blues
news.title_zh: 国际比赛：拉维亚具有里程碑意义，但拉克鲁瓦赢得了蓝军之战
news.body_en: There was Chelsea representation on both sides of the pitch as France snatched a late winner away to Belgium in UEFA Nations League action on Monday night. For the first time in his senior international career, Romeo Lavia was named in the Belgium starting line-up, anchoring the midfield in a double pivot alongside Youri Tielemans. Lavia put in an energetic performance and impressed with his defensive contributions, including a goal-line clearance. For the visitors, Maxence Lacroix helped France to a second clean sheet away from home in the space of four days, with Les Bleus emerging triumphant courtesy of substitute Michael Olise’s 88th-minute winner. The only goal arrived shortly after Lavia was replaced, while Lacroix played the full game. Mike Penders was not involved due to injury. France’s next game is at home to Italy on Friday night, the same evening Belgium host Turkey. At youth level, Chelsea Academy attacker Heze Grimwade scored the winning goal for England Under-17s as they came from behind to beat Israel 2-1 in Germany. The Young Lions equalised with 20 minutes remaining and almost immediately went ahead when substitute Grimwade finished clinically. Josh Henry and Reggie Watson both started the game – the first in a four-nation tournament – with Henry completing the 90 minutes and Watson withdrawn after England went 2-1 ahead. They next play Venezuela on Thursday.
news.body_zh: 周一晚上，法国队在欧洲国家联赛中客场战胜比利时队，球场两侧都有切尔西队的代表。罗密欧·拉维亚在他的国家队职业生涯中首次入选比利时首发阵容，与尤里·蒂莱曼斯一起担任中场双后腰。拉维亚的表现充满活力，他的防守贡献给人留下了深刻的印象，其中包括门线解围。对于客队来说，马克森斯·拉克鲁瓦帮助法国队在四天内第二次客场不失球，而法国队凭借替补迈克尔·奥利斯在第 88 分钟的制胜球取得了胜利。唯一的进球是在拉维亚被换下后不久打进的，而拉克鲁瓦踢满了整场比赛。迈克·潘德斯因伤没有参加比赛。法国队的下一场比赛将于周五晚上主场对阵意大利，同日晚上比利时队将主场迎战土耳其队。在青年组比赛中，切尔西青训球员赫泽·格里姆韦德为英格兰U-17队在德国以2-1逆转击败以色列队打入制胜一球。幼狮队在比赛还剩 20 分钟时扳平比分，并在替补出场的格里姆韦德冷静射门后几乎立即取得领先。乔什·亨利和雷吉·沃森双双首发——这是四国锦标赛中的第一场比赛——亨利打满了90分钟，沃森在英格兰2-1领先后退出。他们下周四将对阵委内瑞拉。

news.title: Analysis: How Chelsea turned the tide against Arsenal
news.title_zh: 分析：切尔西如何力挽狂澜战胜阿森纳
news.body_en: A big crowd, a fantastic mosaic in the West Stand and plenty of pre-match hype meant that our London derby with Arsenal at Stamford Bridge was hotly anticipated. But for all the pre-match buzz, it was the visitors who had the lion's share of the play in the opening stages, hitting the woodwork twice. For a while, it looked like the Blues were in trouble. But some careful game management, a lot of hard graft and a clinical moment from Alyssa Thompson meant that we came away with three precious points. Here's a look at how we did it... After scoring early in our last two matches, the wins over Birmingham City and Austria Vienna, Chelsea struggled to get hold of the ball against Arsenal. Head coach Sonia Bompastor has often spoken about the advantages of scoring early, explaining that it can serve to kill the opposition's hope early on in a game. Yet Arsenal had 65 per cent possession in the first 15 minutes of Sunday's game, leading many to wonder why we were not able to show the same attacking prowess that we had done in the previous two matches. Of course, it's not easy to dominate a high-level opponent, and that fast start was never guaranteed. If the plan was to let Arsenal have the ball early on, then it was difficult to understand why that would be, especially when we were at home. Bompastor confirmed that Arsenal's early dominance was not part of her tactics. 'We didn't start the way we wanted to,' confirmed the head coach afterwards. 'Our game plan was different from what we did in the first 20 minutes. When we got that break, it was the opportunity for me to adjust and to remind the players what we wanted to do on the pitch. 'We were able to recover that ball, and after that, we capitalised on it. But as much as you tell the players before the game that's what you want, sometimes it doesn't go to plan, and you need to find a way for them to adjust.' Reversing such clear momentum is not an easy task, but that's what Bompastor helped her players to do, and in the first 15 minutes of the second half, we enjoyed 72 per cent of the ball. Lucy Bronze has proven that she thrives in high-pressure moments, and has even discussed how she can raise her level when it matters in previous interviews. A home game against rivals Arsenal was one of those occasions for the experienced defender, and a look at her numbers shows how she led by example while wearing the captain's armband. Bronze won five of her six attempted tackles, the most of any Chelsea player on the day. She also made two blocks, won three aerial duels and recovered the ball on five occasions. Not only content to carry out her defensive duties against a quality opponent, she made 16 passes in the final third of the pitch, created one chance and took a shot at goal. It was a trademark battling display from the 34-year-old, and one that certainly helped us secure the win on Sunday. Chelsea Academy graduate Lexi Potter has been playing more minutes this season, and developing an increasingly effective partnership with Keira Walsh. But few would've expected the youngster to be named in the starting line-up against Arsenal, with games of this magnitude often reserved for players with more experience. Bompastor showed how highly she values the youngster by placing her in the XI to start against the Gunners, and explained afterwards why she did so. 'For her age, being able to be consistent in the way she's been performing is great,' said the head coach. 'Probably people were also looking forward to this game to see if, on this big occasion, she was able to repeat and sustain the performance, and she proved that today.' It's not only her own performances that have secured a place in the side for Potter. Her reliability in the deeper midfield slot is allowing Walsh to express her qualities more in attack, as Bompastor also explained. 'Keira is playing at that level because she has more freedom to go forward, because she has Lexi next to her. When Keira is at that level, she's the boss on the pitch.' The graphic above shows how many of Walsh's touches are outside of the centre circle. And when compared to Potter's touch map below, it's clear that the 20-year-old is covering that central area in place of Walsh, allowing her counterpart to make a difference in attack. It's something that Walsh herself spoke about after the Arsenal victory. 'Last year I sometimes let games pass by without having much impact, and that's something I've focused on this season,' said Walsh after the match. 'Having Lexi behind allows me to do that.' It was a tough job to stay high up the pitch against Arsenal, but someone had to do it. The average position graphic below demonstrates how Chelsea were much less positionally aggressive against the Gunners than we have been in other matches this season. Some of that can be put down to playing an opponent who can be extremely dangerous on the counter-attack, but as discussed earlier, much of it was down to those early minutes of domination from the visitors. Up top was Melvine Malard, holding the line, battling for possession and being ready for any out ball that might've come her way. Playing the central striker role isn't always glamorous, but our summer signing has shown she is willing to do the hard work for the team. Taking five shots, two of which were on target, she also completed all eight of her passes in the final third, while winning the ball back twice and completing both of her attempted tackles. This was a clear indication of Malard's value to the team even on a day when she wasn't on the scoresheet.
news.body_zh: 拥挤的人群、西看台上精彩的马赛克以及赛前的大量宣传，意味着我们在斯坦福桥与阿森纳的伦敦德比备受期待。但尽管赛前热闹非凡，但客队在开局阶段占据了最大份额，两次击中门框。有一段时间，蓝军看起来遇到了麻烦。但仔细的比赛管理、大量的努力以及艾莉莎·汤普森的冷静时刻意味着我们获得了宝贵的三分。让我们来看看我们是如何做到的……在过去两场比赛（战胜伯明翰城和奥地利维也纳）中早早进球后，切尔西在对阵阿森纳的比赛中很难控球。主教练索尼娅·邦帕斯特经常谈到早期得分的优势，并解释说这可以在比赛初期扼杀对手的希望。然而，阿森纳在周日比赛的前 15 分钟内拥有 65% 的控球率，这让很多人想知道为什么我们无法展现出前两场比赛那样的进攻能力。当然，压制高水平的对手并不容易，而且快速的开局也无法保证。如果计划是让阿森纳一早就拥有球权，那么很难理解为什么会这样，尤其是当我们在主场的时候。邦帕斯特证实，阿森纳早期的统治地位并不是她战术的一部分。 “我们没有按照我们想要的方式开始，”主教练随后证实。 “我们的比赛计划与前 20 分钟的计划不同。当我们休息时，这是我调整并提醒球员我们想在球场上做什么的机会。 “我们成功地夺回了那个球，之后我们就利用了它。但尽管你在赛前告诉球员这就是你想要的，但有时事情并不会按计划进行，你需要找到一种方法让他们调整。”扭转如此明显的势头并不是一件容易的事，但这就是邦帕斯特帮助她的球员做到的，在下半场的前 15 分钟，我们享受了 72% 的控球率。露西·青铜已经证明了她能够在高压时刻茁壮成长，甚至在之前的采访中讨论过如何在重要时刻提高自己的水平。对于这位经验丰富的后卫来说，主场对阵对手阿森纳的比赛就是其中之一，看看她的数据就可以看出她在佩戴队长袖标时如何以身作则。布朗在六次尝试铲断中赢得了五次，是当天切尔西球员中最多的。她还完成了两次盖帽，赢得了三场空中对抗，并五次夺回球权。她不仅满足于在面对实力强劲的对手时履行防守职责，还在球场最后三分之一区传球16次，创造一次机会并射门。这是这位 34 岁球员标志性的战斗表现，也无疑帮助我们赢得了周日的胜利。切尔西学院毕业生莱克西·波特本赛季的出场时间更长，并与凯拉·沃尔什建立了日益有效的合作关系。但很少有人会想到这名年轻球员会在对阵阿森纳的比赛中首发出场，这种规模的比赛通常是为更有经验的球员准备的。邦帕斯特将这位年轻球员安排在对阵枪手的首发阵容中，这表明了她对这位年轻球员的高度重视，并在事后解释了她这样做的原因。 “对于她的年龄来说，能够保持稳定的表现是很棒的，”主教练说。 “也许人们也在期待这场比赛，看看她是否能够在这个重大场合重复并维持表演，她今天证明了这一点。”不仅仅是她自己的表现为波特赢得了一席之地。正如邦帕斯托尔所解释的那样，她在中场深处的可靠性使沃尔什能够在进攻中更多地表现出她的品质。 “凯拉能打出这样的水平是因为她有更多的自由去前进，因为她身边有莱克西。当凯拉达到那个水平时，她就是球场上的老大。上图显示了沃尔什有多少次触球位于中圈之外。与下面波特的触球图相比，很明显这位 20 岁的球员正在代替沃尔什覆盖中心区域，让她的对手在进攻中发挥作用。这是沃尔什本人在阿森纳获胜后谈到的事情。 “去年我有时会让比赛在没有产生太大影响的情况下过去，这是我本赛季关注的事情，”沃尔什赛后说道。 “有莱克西在身后让我能够做到这一点。”在对阵阿森纳的比赛中保持前场位置是一项艰巨的任务，但必须有人做到这一点。下面的平均位置图显示了切尔西在对阵枪手时的位置攻击性比我们在本赛季其他比赛中要少得多。其中一些可以归因于对手在反击中极其危险，但正如前面所讨论的，很大程度上要归因于客队在比赛开始的几分钟内占据主导地位。位于最前面的是梅尔文·马拉德（Melvine Malard），她坚守阵线，争夺控球权，并为任何可能传到她身上的球做好准备。扮演中锋的角色并不总是那么光鲜亮丽，但我们夏季的签约表明她愿意为球队付出艰苦的努力。她一共射门五次，其中两次射中目标，她还在进攻三区完成了全部八次传球，同时两次夺回球权并完成了两次尝试的铲球。这清楚地表明了马拉德对球队的价值，即使是在她没有进球的那一天。
